projects.title: Sindoraku — BISINDO Gesture Detection
projects.summary: An on-device Android application for real-time Indonesian Sign Language (BISINDO) gesture detection, built with Kotlin and a MobileNetV2 + LSTM model.
projects.description: Sindoraku combines native Android development and machine learning to recognize BISINDO gestures directly from the device camera without requiring an internet connection or server.
highlights: Developed the native Android application in Kotlin for real-time camera-based gesture recognition.
Used MobileNetV2 and LSTM models for BISINDO gesture recognition across 15 words.
Trained and evaluated the model using 255 self-collected gesture videos.
Kept recognition on-device so the application can operate without an internet connection or server.
projects.challenge: Create a practical mobile experience capable of recognizing BISINDO gestures in real time while keeping inference on-device and independent from a remote server.
projects.approach: Built the application natively in Kotlin and integrated a gesture-recognition model powered by MobileNetV2 and LSTM. The model was trained and evaluated on 255 self-collected gesture videos covering 15 BISINDO words.
projects.outcome: The resulting system achieved 96.01% recognition accuracy, 249 ms average detection latency, and 90.97% user acceptance while supporting real-time camera-based recognition without an internet connection.

projects.title: AcademyNTM — Model Recruitment Platform
projects.summary: A web-based recruitment platform for a professional modeling agency, covering registration, profiles, applications, and administrative workflows.
projects.description: AcademyNTM is a full-stack recruitment platform built around a hybrid architecture: Laravel Blade renders the frontend while Node.js and Express.js provide backend services through REST APIs.
highlights: Built model registration, profile management, application submission, and recruitment workflows.
Used Laravel Blade for frontend rendering and Node.js with Express.js for backend services.
Connected the application layers through REST APIs.
Implemented applicant and administrator capabilities including authentication, portfolios, filtering, dashboards, and CRUD operations.
Designed and managed the MySQL database and tested API endpoints with Postman.
projects.challenge: Unify the agency's applicant-facing and administrator workflows in one web platform while keeping frontend rendering and backend services clearly separated.
projects.approach: Used Laravel Blade for frontend rendering and Node.js with Express.js for backend services, connected through REST APIs. The platform includes authentication, profile and portfolio management, filtering, dashboards, application submission, and CRUD operations backed by MySQL.
projects.outcome: Delivered a full-stack recruitment workflow covering model registration, profile management, applications, and administrative operations, with the API layer tested using Postman.

projects.title: BuzzBuzz — Movie & TV Tracking App
projects.summary: A native Android application for tracking movies and TV shows through ratings, reviews, watch history, and custom watchlists.
projects.description: BuzzBuzz focuses on straightforward personal media tracking with a native Kotlin implementation and an interface designed to stay simple and distraction-free.
highlights: Developed the application natively in Kotlin for Android.
Implemented watch history, ratings, reviews, and custom watchlist management.
Focused the user interface on smooth performance, ease of use, and distraction-free media tracking.
projects.challenge: Create a simple personal media-tracking experience that keeps the core actions—remembering, rating, reviewing, and organizing titles—easy to reach.
projects.approach: Built the application natively in Kotlin and centered the product around watch history, ratings, reviews, and custom watchlists with a straightforward interface.
projects.outcome: Delivered a focused Android application for organizing movie and TV viewing activity without overloading the experience with unnecessary interface complexity.

projects.title: Manakeu — Financial Management Backend
projects.summary: A Node.js and Express.js backend for centralized project, finance, budget, approval, reporting, communication, and payment workflows.
projects.description: Manakeu is a backend-focused financial management system with authentication, authorization, caching, activity logging, validation, external service integrations, and documented REST APIs.
highlights: Built backend services for projects, transactions, budgets, approvals, and reporting.
Implemented JWT authentication, Google OAuth 2.0, role-based access control, Redis caching, activity logging, and input validation.
Integrated WhatsApp, Twilio, and Midtrans APIs for messaging, SMS/voice communication, and payments.
Documented the REST API using Swagger/OpenAPI 3.0.
projects.challenge: Support several financial-management workflows in a centralized backend while covering authentication, permissions, performance, auditability, communication, and payments.
projects.approach: Built the backend with Node.js and Express.js, adding JWT authentication, Google OAuth 2.0, RBAC, Redis caching, activity logging, input validation, external communication/payment integrations, and Swagger/OpenAPI 3.0 documentation.
projects.outcome: Produced a backend foundation that supports project and financial operations alongside secure access control, caching, activity tracking, messaging, voice/SMS communication, payments, and documented APIs.
